summary.en-US: Unload the current tab with a keyboard shortcut (Cmd+Shift+U / Ctrl+Shift+U) and jump straight back to the tab you used last.

description.en-US:
Press Cmd+Shift+U (macOS) or Ctrl+Shift+U (Windows/Linux) to unload the tab you're on. Firefox frees its memory and CPU, and you're taken back to the tab you were using before it.

The unloaded tab stays in the tab bar and reloads when you click it again. It's the same as the built-in "Unload Tab" item in the tab context menu, just on a key.

Change the shortcut: about:addons → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

No permissions, no data collection. Source code: https://github.com/semihsmg/quick-unload-tab
